resolution.method: EAS exact match on 100 01ST ST → parcel 3721001; sf-parcels has blklot 3721001 active, 100–104 01ST; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1988. EAS puts 100, 104 01ST ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 100. The record writes the street 1ST; EAS holds the numbered streets zero-padded to four characters, so this is 01ST.
